# APEX — Enterprise Operations Control Node
> High-performance B2B Multi-Tenant SaaS platform designed for telemetry control, offline-first biometric selfie attendance verification, Kanban tasks, and low-stock SKU inventory management.

## Canonical Web Resources
- [Apex Home](https://apex.lankdev.com/): Official platform capabilities, features, and pricing.
- [Workspace Sign In](https://apex.lankdev.com/login): Tenant access portal for administrators, managers, and employees.
- [Workspace Registration](https://apex.lankdev.com/register): Instant enterprise onboarding and workspace provisioning.
- [Join Workspace](https://apex.lankdev.com/join): Fast invite-code employee onboarding.

## Architecture & System Capabilities
- **Multi-Tenant Isolation**: Dedicated database tenant boundaries with Row Level Security (RLS) across all entities.
- **Biometric Attendance Verification**: On-the-fly client-compressed selfie capture with geolocation coordinates and offline queue sync.
- **Kanban Task Workflow**: Real-time task board with role-gated mutations.
- **Inventory Telemetry**: Continuous SKU status monitoring with critical low-stock triggers (<= 10 units).
- **Security & Integrity**: Fail-closed API gates, HMAC-SHA256 authenticated webhooks, in-memory rate limiting, and encrypted client storage.
